rules: Retain the 20 previously inspected text cases excluding periodicals, teaching presentation and blank notes page, plus all 10 inspected table cases. Fill text to 30 with the first 10 SHA256(path)-ordered uninspected business-keyword filenames. Page excerpts do not measure whole-document completion or operational invoice extraction.
